Players Committee card image of [[Aayla Secura (Holo AI) (Errata 3)]] (errata PC-E4), game text: “Power +1 for each opponent's character here. When with two of your aliens (or clones), adds one battle destiny. May not be targeted by weapons unless each of your other aliens and clones present are 'hit.' Immune to You Are Beaten and attrition < 5.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/aaylasecura_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/793bf6567aab6b7f98de47650aedffa0d0097f93 793bf65] (15 January 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
